channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: USDA defends $12 billion subsidy amid farm economy challenges
item.description: As the U.S. Department of Agriculture prepares to dole out $12 billion (C$16.4 billion) in government subsidies next week, officials and economists at the agency’s annual forum near Washington defended the assistance as a necessary measure to prevent more farmers from financial ruin.

item.title: U.S. trade rep credits Trump for ‘paradigm shift’
item.description: USTR chief agriculture negotiator says Trump has transformed trade negotiations with a goal of turning a trade deficit into a surplus.

item.title: OPINION: Three ways Canada can navigate an increasingly erratic and belligerent United States
item.description: As Canada navigates this belligerent U.S. government, a lingering question is whether this history of interwoven reciprocity is deteriorating into a complex entanglement of vulnerability.

item.title: Big dollars for late adopters of on-farm BMPs
item.description: Some Canadian farmers are pocketing nearly $200,000 a year in environmental incentives from government, non-profits and private companies.

item.title: Indonesia opens market to Canadian pork, expands beef access
item.description: Indonesia has opened its market to Canadian pork and expanded access for beef imports, the Canadian government announced Monday.

item.title: Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea found on a southern Alberta farm
item.description: Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea virus has been detected at a southern Alberta farm, Alberta Pork said Feb.23.

item.title: Alberta-based Sunterra seeks appeal of cheque-kiting decision
item.description: Sunterra Farms has asked to appeal the court decision finding the company and principal Ray Price guilty of fraud against an American lender.

item.title: Sask. tree farm operator charged under immigration legislation
item.description: A Weyburn, Sask., man has been charged with three offences under foreign worker and immigration legislation.

item.title: Year-round food production coming to Saskatchewan First Nation
item.description: Cowessess First Nation is planning to construct another sustainable project with the help of the federal government.

item.title: U.S. ethanol industry sets its sights on the world
item.description: Canada remains the top buyer of U.S. ethanol but Mexico and Japan have huge potential.
